artifact_observations.reasoning: Significant motion blur on the throwing arm. While physically accurate for a fast pitch, AI generators often struggle with this, resulting in 'melting' rather than optical blur. Here it looks mostly like optical blur but edges are slightly soft/mushy where they meet the background.
The letters appear slightly warped and lack the crisp stitching texture of real fabric. The 'S' blends slightly into the fold of the shirt.
The collar and shoulder seam on the left side (viewer's right) appear somewhat indistinct and merge softly with the neck skin tone, lacking clear structural definition.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific team identity (Mets) and verify the image classifies correctly as a professional baseball player rather than a generic athlete.
To audit the skeletal structure of the torso and arms, ensuring the twisting motion of the pitch is anatomically plausible and limbs are not fused or extra.
To check for edge bleeding between the white uniform and the dark background, and to ensure the cap brim is a distinct, solid object.
To evaluate the realism of the motion blur and identify any subtle noise or texture inconsistencies in the skin and fabric.

focus_areas: Anatomical correctness of the pitching motion (arm rotation)
Integrity of text/insignia on the jersey
Edge sharpness between subject and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'METS' lettering. AI often generates gibberish text that looks like letters from a distance. Verify if the letters are structurally sound. Also, scrutinize the throwing hand; ensure fingers are not fused into a blob despite the blur. Check if the belt loops connect logically to the pants.
